_source: THE VT RULE BOOK OF RECORD (Spec Kit 071). Finalised from specs/071-vehicle-tracking-analytics/rules-draft.json; the evidence for every value is in that draft, spec.md (F1-F12, A1-A12, D7) and specs/vt-analytics/workbook-rules.md. The operative copy is VT_RULES inlined in nicks_code/vt-engine.js (the apps run from file://): every key here that does not start with '_' must equal VT_RULES field by field - nicks_code/diagnostics/verify-vt-rules.mjs fails on drift. Change both together, with a dated _changes[] entry.

_changes.why: first rule book of record; _evidence prose dropped (it lives in the draft and the spec), _cells kept

the draft said 'must equal MTD_RULES.vat', and MTD_RULES.vat is the MULTIPLIER 1.15 (specs/mtd_engine_rules.json reference_data.vat_multiplier); stored the same way so the equality is literal. Fitted value = charge ex VAT x vat

the one-off 4 Nov 2026 election holiday (MTD_RULES.extraHolidays, mirrored; verify-vt-rules fails if the two differ). It explains A4: the November cycle has 23 weekdays and the Sales Review budgets 22 dialing days
the chain keys are the seller_match values stored on the case (plan DB-2)
US2-2: an agent with no in-play case this business month is listed as notRated why 'nodata', never shown a zero score

A6 made operative: a case first seen on the book's opening extract (book.openedOn) has no sale day unless the opening book supplies one; working days for the rating start the day after the opening extract when no opening book was loaded

_changes.by: Spec Kit 071 derived-cancellation builder (owner: "ok do the recommend fix")
_changes.why: No upload carries a cancellation (BI Active Fitted is active-only: Contract Status Active on all 19,404 rows, Contract Deactivate Date blank on every row; S&M Status holds attempts only), but the hand report marks 90 of the 93 current-month sales that are in NEITHER 10 Nov file Cancelled (97 %). A Scheduled/Missed case absent from both files of a complete extract day is now Cancelled, reason dropped; a BI row with a deactivate date or a non-Active Contract Status is Cancelled, reason deactivated. Cancelled is a count (0 when none) and Cancellation % = cancelled / sales sits beside the 5 % budget. Supersedes spec A8 ('Cancelled not invented').

the exact trigger: evaluated by the commit of an extract day's second file, against that day's two files, only when no later extract day is complete; a dropped case returns on a file of its cancellation day or later; a deactivated case only on a newer Active BI row; a fitted case is never cancelled by absence
an explicit deactivation in the BI file wins over Fitted for that case (R4)
the two BI contract columns, read by position (else by name), optional: a file without them deactivates nothing

_changes.to: Cancelled count; canRate = cancelled / sales; canBudget = budgets[cycle].cancelled[sub]; fitDone keeps an install that was later deactivated
_changes.why: R6; denominators stay ALL the set's sales (a cancelled sale stays in Sales, as the hand report's Sale Count = 1 on cancelled rows)

columns.discardAll: every column not listed above (customer name, mobile, registration, chassis, box, account/contract numbers, consultants, fitment partner, last modified by)
columns.dateSerial: Excel 1900 serial, integer part; text dates refused

status.acrossExtracts: newer extract decides between missed and scheduled

dropped.absentFrom: both files of the extract day
dropped.trigger: the commit of the second file of an extract day, only when no later extract day is complete
dropped.returns: seen again in a file of that extract day or later: takes that file's status

deactivated.when: Contract Deactivate Date (P) not blank, or Contract Status (B) not blank and not activeStatus
deactivated.onDate: the deactivate date, never before the case's previous status day nor after the extract day; no date: the extract day
deactivated.returns: a newer BI row that is Active with no deactivate date: fitted

cancellation._note: see _changes 2026-11-23 status.cancelledFrom and spec.md A8 (superseded) / A13

saleDay.openingBook: takes RPT 'Schedulers Data'!B for its cases
saleDay.openingWithoutDate: null - in play, never counted as a sale on any day

identity.unmatched: excluded from agent rows; counted on the receipt and in floor.unmatched

periods.cycleKeyBy: month the cycle ends in (cycle-YYYY-MM, worker/src/cycle.mjs)
periods.workingDay: Mon-Fri and not dataOnlyDay (SA public holidays + extraHolidays)

reports.inPlay: sold in cycle OR (sold earlier AND (open at any time in cycle OR fitted in cycle))

columns.label: Rollover
columns.f: count(set where saleDay < cycle.from or saleDay null)

columns.label: Cancelled
columns.basis: status as at (the event's day: the complete extract day it dropped out, or the deactivate date)

columns.label: Fitments done
columns.f: count(cases fitted, or fitted and later deactivated, fittedDay in window)

columns.label: Working days
columns.f: working days from max(cycle.from, agent start, first tracked day) to last extract

columns.label: % to target
columns.f: spd / target; teams: sum(current of targeted agents) / sum(target x workingDays)

columns.label: Fitted value (incl VAT, Charge Amount basis)

reports.totals: sum of counts; rates = ratio of sums

drivers.label: Target Achievement
drivers.target: Agent List Target (AL VT!I) for the cycle's list
drivers.note: How close your sales per working day come to your target.

drivers.label: Fitment Rate
drivers.note: Out of every 100 of your sales in play this month, how many are fitted.

drivers.label: Missed Rate
drivers.note: How many of your sales missed their fitment appointment. Lower is better.

drivers.label: Fitted vs target
drivers.note: Fitments done this month against what your target would fit.
